mappings.coverage: complete qualified meaningful low16 return and unchanged backing projection
mappings.qualification: Three own bodies5d92b0 scene query,5d9220 containment and5d9290 low16 count accessor. Read-only geometry image, meaningful low16 returns and native containment visitation sequences checked. Exactx8764 plane products/adds with one binary32 spill; finite inputs can spill signedInfinity and retain sign selection. Existing FiniteX87 primitive reused without additional helper credit. Preserves original pre-store first/second flag check, unsigned priority replacement only on third match, first shared low16 plane ID list order, signed16 shared-plane index and negative-vs-nonnegative side selection. Actual5c12e0 debug calls execute a one-byte RET, no service and no separate own-body credit. Count accessor has no identified live Ghidra procedure at5d9290; original byte decode and8native executions retained explicitly. Query and containment have exact matching live REA body bounds.
